name: Buy Now Popup Instant Checkout LITE for WooCommerce
author: Wize WP

sections.description:
Buy Now Popup Instant Checkout LITE for WooCommerce replaces the slow, multi-step checkout process with a beautiful, mobile-friendly popup that lets customers place their order instantly.

No long checkout pages, no unnecessary steps – just a faster way to turn visitors into buyers.

Why Choose This Plugin?

  • Increase Conversions – Faster checkout = more completed orders.
  • Reduce Cart Abandonment – Customers buy directly from the popup.
  • Easy to Use – Simple admin panel, no coding required.
  • Works with Most Themes – Follows WooCommerce standards.

👉 Want more power? The PRO version includes Stripe & PayPal support, drag-and-drop field editor, custom fields, advanced shortcode, badges, per-product control and more.
Upgrade to PRO →

Key Features (LITE)

  • Quick Buy Now Button – Add to product & shop pages automatically.
  • Instant Popup Checkout – Customers skip the cart page and checkout in a popup.
  • Basic Checkout Fields – Uses WooCommerce default fields (billing & shipping).
  • Cash on Delivery & Check Payments – Works with standard WooCommerce gateways.
  • Free Shipping Message (simple) – Display a text-only message.
  • Shortcode Support – [wcbnpc_buy_now id='PRODUCT_ID'] to add Buy Now button anywhere.
  • Clean Admin UI – Configure button behavior and general settings easily.

🎯 Perfect For:

  • Fashion & Apparel Stores
  • Electronics & Gadgets Shops
  • Beauty & Cosmetic Brands
  • Home & Lifestyle Stores
  • Digital & Downloadable Products
  • Anyone who wants faster checkout without complexity

External Services

This plugin connects to an external service provided by WizeWP (https://wizewp.com) in order to retrieve important product announcements, updates, offers or critical notifications.

  • What data is sent: No personal data is transmitted. Only a simple HTTP GET request is performed to retrieve public JSON data.
  • When: Only when you access the plugin’s admin settings page.
  • Service provided by: WizeWP (https://wizewp.com)
  • Privacy Policy: https://wizewp.com/privacy-policy/
  • Terms of Service: https://wizewp.com/terms-of-service/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin:

    • Download the plugin zip file.
    • In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
    • Upload the zip file and click “Install Now.”

  2. Activate the Plugin:

    • After installation, click “Activate” to enable the plugin.

  3. Configure Settings:

    • Navigate to WooCommerce > Buy Now Popup in the WordPress admin.
    • Customize general settings, checkout fields, payment methods, and shipping options to suit your store.

  4. Add the Buy Now Button:

    • The button automatically appears on product and shop pages (based on settings).
    • Use the shortcode [wcbnpc_buy_now id='PRODUCT_ID' text='Custom Text'] to add the button to any page or post.

  5. Test Your Setup:

    • Visit a product page or use the shortcode [wcbnpc_buy_now id='PRODUCT_ID'] to ensure the popup works as expected.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with all payment gateways?

The LITE version supports Cash on Delivery (COD) and Check Payments.
👉 The PRO version adds support for Stripe, PayPal, and more gateways.

Can I customize checkout fields?

In the LITE version, the default WooCommerce checkout fields are used.
👉 The PRO version allows drag-and-drop customization, adding new fields, and advanced control.

Can I disable the Buy Now button for specific products?

This option is only available in the PRO version. In LITE, the button is enabled globally.

Is the plugin compatible with my theme?

Yes, it is designed to work with most WooCommerce-compatible themes.
